column1: eTable 69.4  Precautions for Procedures and Surgery in Kidney Transplant Recipients •	 Caution with radiocontrast exposure •	 Maintain hydration •	 Avoid nephrotoxic antibiotics and analgesic •	 “Stress-dose steroids” is not always necessary •	 If enteral route of medication is contraindicated, give tacrolimus sublingually if able (1/2 total oral dose) If enteral route of medication is contraindicated/sublingual tacrolimus is not available, give calcineurin inhibitor via intravenous route (1/3 total oral dose for cyclosporine; 1/5 total oral dose for tacrolimus) •	 Monitor allograft function, plasma potassium, and acid-base balance daily •	 Consider wound-healing impairment with sirolimus
